## Public API

### `influx.config`
- class `InfluxSectionConfig` — ``[influx]`` top-level settings.
- class `ScheduleConfig` — ``[schedule]`` cron schedule for ingestion runs.
- class `InboxConfig` — ``[inbox]`` manual-submission inbox settings.
- class `ArchivePolicyConfig` — ``[storage.archive_policy]`` domain-aware archive policy overrides (#149).
- class `StorageConfig` — ``[storage]`` archive storage settings.
- class `NotificationsConfig` — ``[notifications]`` webhook notification settings.
- class `LithosConfig` — ``[lithos]`` Lithos MCP connection settings (§19).
- class `SecurityConfig` — ``[security]`` SSRF guard and security settings.
- class `NotificationWebhookConfig` — One configured outbound notification sink.
- class `ProfileThresholds` — ``[profiles.thresholds]`` score thresholds per profile.
- class `ArxivSourceConfig` — ``[profiles.sources.arxiv]`` arXiv source settings.
- class `RssSourceEntry` — ``[[profiles.sources.rss]]`` one RSS feed entry.
- class `ProfileSources` — ``[profiles.sources]`` source configuration per profile.
- class `ProfileConfig` — ``[[profiles]]`` one interest profile.
- class `ProviderConfig` — ``[providers.*]`` LLM provider connection info.
- class `ModelSlotConfig` — ``[models.*]`` LLM model slot configuration (FR-CFG-6).
- class `PromptEntryConfig` — One prompt entry — inline ``text`` or file ``path``.
- class `PromptsConfig` — ``[prompts]`` all three canonical prompt keys required (FR-CFG-7).
- class `FilterTuningConfig` — ``[filter]`` filter batch and scoring parameters.
- class `ExtractionConfig` — ``[extraction]`` text extraction quality gates.
- class `ResilienceConfig` — ``[resilience]`` retry and backoff settings.
- class `FeedbackConfig` — ``[feedback]`` negative-example injection settings.
- class `RepairConfig` — ``[repair]`` repair/upgrade batch limits.
- class `TelemetryConfig` — ``[telemetry]`` OTEL observability settings.
- class `AppConfig` — Root configuration model for the full v0.7 TOML schema.
- def `find_config_path` — Return the first existing ``influx.toml`` in the discovery order.
- def `load_config` — Load, validate, and return the v0.7 ``AppConfig``.

### `influx.probes`
- class `ProbeResult` — Outcome of a single probe check.
- class `ProbeState` — Aggregated cached probe state read by ``/ready`` and ``/status``.
- class `ProbeLoop` — Background probe loop that caches Lithos + LLM-credentials state.

### `influx.prompts`
- def `extract_variables` — Return the set of template variable names found in *template*.
- def `load_prompt` — Load prompt content from *text* or *path*.
- def `validate_prompt_variables` — Validate that *template* uses exactly the required variables for *prompt_key*.

### `influx.slugs`
- def `slugify_feed_name` — Turn a free-form feed name into an FR-ST-2 slug.
- def `is_valid_slug` — Return *True* if *value* is a valid FR-ST-2 slug.
